jobs.description:
Are you accurate, flexible, and do you enjoy working in a clean production environment? For a modern food company in Zottegem, we are looking for packers.

Below is the list of tasks for this position:

• Correctly packaging fine food products according to the established standards. 
• Carrying out quality checks to ensure that every product meets our high standards. 
• Setting up and adjusting machines to guarantee a smooth production process. 
• Working together with colleagues to ensure deadlines are met and customers remain satisfied. 
• As a packer, you make sure our products are perfectly packaged before they are sent to our customers.

• You can speak Dutch or English.
• You can work either from 6h-14h, 14h-22h or 22h-6h. 
• You are at least 3 days a week available to work.
• You can choose which day and shift you wanna work.
• You have experience in a production environment.

About the role
 

Fintensy builds and operates the technology platform behind mozzeno and other financial services. As we scale, we're looking for a Head of IT to grow our engineering team, sharpen how we work, and make sure our technology delivers on the business's ambitions.
 

This is a leadership role first and foremost. You will spend your time developing people, aligning ways of working, leading our technical initiatives, and giving stakeholders clear visibility into what the team is building and where it is headed. While you won't be writing production code day to day, your credibility with the team comes from having built and operated systems like these yourself.
 

Key responsibilities
 
 

• Team leadership & coaching — Provide mentorship and day-to-day support to developers and data scientists, fostering a culture of continuous learning. Help senior engineers grow junior colleagues and keep knowledge flowing across the team. 

• Technical project leadership — Lead the delivery of technical projects end to end — infrastructure, platform, security, tooling and cross-cutting engineering initiatives — from scoping through rollout. Business-driven projects are owned by Product Owners; you partner closely with them while taking the lead on the technical roadmap and its execution. 

• Recruitment & onboarding — Lead hiring for developers, infrastructure engineers, and data & AI specialists. Design and oversee onboarding that integrates new hires quickly and effectively into the team and its practices. 

• Process refinement — Work with Product Owners to shape and fine-tune agile practices (backlog management, sprint planning, retrospectives) that maximise productivity and keep focus on strategic priorities. Continuously trial new techniques — such as AI-assisted coding and process automation — to raise efficiency and quality. 

• Visibility & communication — Ensure transparent reporting of achievements, roadmaps and risks to stakeholders. Run regular updates on progress, risks and resource needs, and build a shared understanding of priorities across engineering, product and business. 

• Collaboration & facilitation — Act as the bridge between developers, Product Owners, data scientists and external partners. Facilitate discussions on requirements and dependencies so projects run smoothly and teams stay aligned. 

• Technical oversight — Bring deep, hands-on experience with our stack or equivalent (AWS, .NET, Angular, Python, event-driven micro-services), enough real depth to debug a production issue or challenge an architectural decision yourself, not just follow the conversation.  Champion security best practices and infrastructure improvements, while delegating implementation to subject-matter experts. 

• Culture & growth — Foster an environment where engineers feel accountable and empowered to take ownership. Encourage curiosity and a pragmatic, solution-oriented mindset, and promote AI and emerging tools that streamline work and sharpen the team's skills. 
 

• Several years of hands-on experience as a Software Engineer, Architect, or DevOps/Platform Engineer, ideally followed by a move into a people-management or tech-lead role. 
 

• Experience managing engineering or cross-functional teams, with a track record of coaching people and growing their skills. 

• A record of leading technical projects or initiatives through to delivery. 

• Proven ability to design and refine agile or lean processes that improve delivery effectiveness. 

• Excellent interpersonal and communication skills; comfortable presenting plans, progress and blockers to technical and non-technical audiences alike. 

• Organised and detail-oriented, able to juggle multiple initiatives without losing sight of the big picture. 

• Comfortable introducing new tools and techniques (e.g., AI-assisted development) and measuring their impact. 

• Enough technical literacy in cloud infrastructure, web technologies and DevOps pipelines to understand team challenges and shape high-level decisions. 

• Fluency in French or Dutch alongside professional English.  

Nice to have
 
 

• Prior experience in fintech or other regulated environments. 

• Experience working with near-shore or hybrid teams.

You will be a member of the SEM/TEM team. This team is responsible for in-line and out-of-line released electron microscopy inspection.  As a TEM technician you ensure the smooth processing of the various TEM inspections, focusing on the quality of the inspection. 

As SEM/TEM technician you will have the following key responsibilities: 

• You follow-up the inline TEM queue.
• You adjust released recipes for automated TEM inspections.
• You are responsible for (semi)-automated and guided TEM inspections.
• You contribute to achieving targets.
• You help with statistical process control (SPC) on TEM tools. 

• Preferable you have a bachelor’s degree or associate degree (2-year program) in science (chemistry, biology, physics) or equal to experience.
• It would be a great plus if you have hands-on experience with automated metrology or SEM/TEM inspections in the semi-conductor industry.  
• You are a strong planner and you would enjoy working in a fast-paced environment. You certainly know how to multi-task and prioritize assignments.  
• You are a communicative team player with a very good knowledge of both English and Dutch.
• You are prepared to work in a shift system (early/late/night and 1 weekend out of 4).

D-NETWORK is looking for an IT Engineering Manager for an international medical technology company based in Mechelen.

 

The Opportunity :

Our client is looking for an Engineering Manager – Product Platform to strengthen the foundations of its platform engineering organisation. You will lead a group of engineering contributors and make sure the underlying software platforms stay reliable, compliant and ready for future growth.

You will manage Tech Leads and Software Engineers and keep the different teams and functions aligned. You are responsible for the health, stability and evolution of the platforms, balancing people leadership, technical direction and delivery quality. In a regulated medical device setting, you will work closely with engineering, verification, quality, security and regulatory colleagues to deliver solutions that are both innovative and compliant.

This role suits a leader who pairs technical credibility with strong people skills and enjoys complex, cross-functional environments.

 

Key Responsibilities

Build and grow the engineering team

• Foster an engineering culture centred on dependable delivery, quality and continuous improvement
• Coach and develop Tech Leads and engineers, building leadership depth and succession readiness
• Set clear priorities and structured leadership routines in a safe, inclusive team environment
• Drive hiring, onboarding and long-term capability planning
Guide technical direction and platform integrity

• Define and evolve the technical roadmap for the platform components
• Contribute to architecture and design governance together with the Tech Leads
• Stay close to the most complex technical challenges and risk areas
• Promote modern practices such as secure coding, CI/CD and automation
Align teams and deliveries

• Coordinate software, embedded, verification, quality and regulatory teams
• Manage dependencies, integration points and release-readiness milestones
• Simplify the architecture and improve platform interfaces and boundaries
Lead through Tech Leads and strengthen governance

• Lead a group of Tech Leads across platform domains, with clear ownership and accountability
• Set up solid governance routines (design reviews, decision logs, roadmap alignment)
• Embed the discipline required in regulated environments: traceability, testability and reproducibility
Partner with stakeholders

• Work with R&D, Quality, Regulatory and Delivery colleagues
• Report clearly on platform health, risks and progress
• Keep technical debt and defects visible and properly prioritised
Champion quality and compliance

• Ensure compliance with medical device regulations and the company’s quality management system
• Build quality into everyday engineering practice
• Balance agile delivery with regulatory rigour

Your Profile

Required

• Master’s or PhD in a relevant scientific or engineering discipline (or equivalent). For degrees obtained outside Belgium, a formal recognition process may be part of the hiring journey, and support will be provided
• Proven experience as an Engineering Manager leading software teams in complex environments
• Strong experience leading through Tech Leads
• Ability to build leadership depth and scalable team structures
• Solid technical background, able to take part in architecture and design decisions
• Strong communication and stakeholder management skills across diverse functions
 

Preferred

• Experience in medical device software or other regulated industries
• Background in platform engineering, middleware or shared components
• Experience driving engineering maturity, CI/CD and automation
• Track record of improving quality, reliability and engineering standards
 

Languages

• Fluent professional English (spoken and written) is mandatory
• Dutch and/or French is an advantage but not required

jobs.occupation: Nexin - Medior / Senior BizTalk and .NET Developer
jobs.description:
Our client is a well-established Belgian logistics and distribution company operating nationwide with multiple sites across the country.

The organization manages time-sensitive distribution flows and supplies thousands of retail points daily. As part of its strategic evolution, the company is expanding into new product categories while modernizing its IT landscape.
The environment combines

• A stable SME culture with flat hierarchy

• Long-term employee retention

• High operational criticality

• A strong ongoing digital transformation program

To strengthen the internal IT team, our client is looking for a Medior / Senior BizTalk & .NET Developer (minimum 5 years of experience).
Your role

You will join an experienced internal IT department (infrastructure + development) and actively contribute to the evolution of business-critical applications.

You will:

•  Design, develop and maintain integrations using Microsoft BizTalk Server 2020 and C#/.NET.

• Create and maintain schemas, MAPS, orchestrations, pipelines, ports and adapter configurations.

• Develop .NET components, services and REST/SOAP integrations; work with XML, XSD, XSLT and JSON.

• Write and optimize SQL Server queries and stored procedures, and implement validation, error handling and logging.

• Translate business requirements into technical solutions with business analysts and application owners.

 

Day to day support

• Monitor interfaces and application health; investigate failed exchanges, suspended messages and processing delays.

• Handle daily support requests and production incidents, prioritize business impact and keep users informed.

• Diagnose issues across BizTalk, .NET, SQL Server and connected systems; coordinate resolution with IT teams and external partners.

• Restore processing safely, including controlled message resubmission, and investigate root causes to prevent recurring incidents.

• Maintain support procedures, runbooks and incident records; turn recurring problems into permanent improvements.

 

Quality and delivery

• Test integrations and .NET changes, including failure scenarios, and contribute to code reviews.

• Manage source code in GIT and support deployments with environment-specific configurations and rollback procedures.

• Document interfaces and technical changes, and share knowledge with colleagues.

You will collaborate closely with business stakeholders and operational teams. As a BizTalk and .NET developer, you will work in tandem with another colleague
Work environment

• Multicultural team

• Flat organizational structure

• Short decision-making lines

• Strong collaboration culture

• Fun culture

• On-site presence in Belgium required (with homeworking)

• At least 5 years of professional experience in software development, including proven experience developing and supporting Microsoft BizTalk and C#/.NET solutions, ideally with BizTalk Server 2020.

• Strong C# and .NET Framework skills, with hands-on experience in Visual Studio.

• Practical knowledge of BizTalk messaging, routing, promoted properties, MAPS, orchestrations and pipelines.

• Experience with XML/XSD, XSLT, JSON, REST/SOAP services and adapters such as sFTP and WCF-SQL.

• Solid SQL Server skills and experience troubleshooting integration or application issues in production.

• Experience with GIT, testing and structured deployment practices.

• Ability and willingness to combine development work with daily application support.

• Proven use of AI tools in software development, such as coding assistants for implementation, testing, debugging and documentation, with critical review of generated output and respect for data confidentiality.

• Fluent in Dutch or French, with a good working command of English.

 

Additional assets

• Experience with SAP integrations, EDI/AS2 or other enterprise systems.

• Knowledge of modern .NET, ASP.NET Core, Azure Logic Apps, Service Bus or API Management.

• Experience with CI/CD, PowerShell, monitoring tools, or Jira and Confluence.

• Knowledge of Broadcom Automic for scheduling and monitoring automated jobs and workflows.

 

Soft skills

• An analytical mindset and a methodical approach to troubleshooting.

• Ownership of issues through to resolution, with clear communication and a focus on business needs.

• Ability to manage priorities calmly, collaborate with colleagues and document solutions clearly.

Your responsibilities
 
 

• Demonstrates insight in the development and delivery of the IA Plan 

• Develops risk and audit needs assessments underpinning the Annual IA Plan. 

• Supports development of the risk-based annual IA Plan. 

• Supports the timely delivery of the annual IA Plan and Excecute the audit plan. 

• Supports the delivery of the comprehensive risk-based IA Plans and leads audits within their remit. 

• Undertakes IA activities in line with Athora IA Policies and procedures, and quality standards. 

• Maintain strong knowledge of Athora, the Athora Strategy, its operations and the key current and emerging risks to inform audit planning. 

• Consistently demonstrates, drives and delivers quality deliverables and timeliness in all activities. Succeeds in “getting it right first time”. 

• Accountable for quality and internal firm requirements, and Athora IA methodology compliance on all assignments. 

• Effectively leads delivery teams by monitoring audit progress and outcomes, balancing stakeholder needs and team member development. 

• Supports the preparation of internal audit reports and audit committee reporting. 

• Develops robust relationships with stakeholders (including Senior Management). 

• Builds and maintains deep relationships with peers and stakeholders across functions. 

• Demonstrates and drives continued learning Assists in the development or enhancement of Athora IA audit methodologies and tools and seeks opportunities to enhance the effectiveness of the IA function. 

• Supports the GCIA/local HIA and Senior IA Director in ad hoc strategic and operational IA function activities, as required. 

• Seeks opportunities for development and increased responsibilities.  

Functional or Technical Knowledge and Skill Required
 
 

• CRMA/CISA/CIA designation (or equivalent) preferred. 

• Substantial internal and/or external audit experience required [typically 6-8 years, ideally including 'big-four']. 

• Knowledge of insurance/reinsurance industries, including corporate investment and corporate finance areas. 

• Knowledge of Solvency II and general understanding of statutory reporting requirements. 

• Demonstrated leadership in managing people and projects. 

• Proven track record within internal/external audit environment evidencing strong performance in conducting high quality audit work, findings and reports. 

• Experience with effective interaction with members of senior management. 

• Familiar with risk-based and business process focused audit approach. 

• Strong computer skills with experience in system-based audits would be an advantage. 

• Excellent written and oral communication skills in French, English and ideally Dutch.

Responsibilities

• Provide technical direction for frontend development and promote consistent application architecture and coding standards.
• Develop features, reusable components, and technical improvements using modern .NET and Blazor.
• Design scalable and maintainable user interface structures that align with accessibility and design system standards.
• Collaborate with analysts, architects, and stakeholders to translate business requirements into robust technical solutions.
• Integrate web applications with secure APIs and implement robust authentication flows.
• Ensure high code quality through structured peer reviews, static analysis, and comprehensive testing strategies.
• Support the continuous improvement of engineering practices and coach other developers to foster technical excellence.

Requirements

• You have 8+ years of backend development experience with C# and Agile methodologies.
• You possess 6+ years of experience with Modern .NET and ASP.NET Core.
• You bring 6+ years of experience in frontend development using HTML, CSS, and Responsive Design.
• You're experienced with 6+ years of Testing and quality practices, including unit testing, integration testing, and UI automation.
• You have 6+ years of experience managing delivery with Git, Azure DevOps, and CI/CD pipelines.
• You possess 5+ years of experience implementing Security and identity protocols via OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, and JWT.
• You bring 5+ years of experience in Data and integration with Entity Framework Core and SQL.
• You've worked for 3+ years with Blazor and Razor components.
• You have 3+ years of experience delivering solutions that meet Web accessibility and WCAG 2.1 AA standards.
• You are fluent in English with mastery of either French or Dutch.
Nice to Haves

• 3+ years of experience with Cloud platforms specifically Microsoft Azure.
• 2+ years of experience with Distributed systems and messaging via Azure Service Bus or NServiceBus.
• 2+ years of experience with JavaScript or TypeScript and frontend interoperability.
• 1+ years of experience using AI-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot or Claude Code.
• Knowledge of .NET Framework maintenance and passive knowledge of Dutch or French.

Job description 

Are you an experienced truck driver with a passion for the open road? We're looking for a professional and motivated CE driver to join our team for international and national transport routes.

As a driver, you will be responsible for the safe and timely delivery of palletized goods to our clients, including well-known companies like Hubo and Gamma. Your duties include loading and unloading the truck independently and ensuring deliveries to around five customers per day.

You’ll spend +/- 3 nights per week in your truck, giving you the freedom and independence that come with this role. Your routes will mainly take you through the Benelux, Northern France, and the Ruhr region. You are also responsible for maintaining the black box records and accurately completing CMR documents.

You will work closely with the planning department and always adhere to traffic rules and safety regulations. With your professional and safety-first mindset, you help ensure satisfied customers and a smooth operation.

What We Offer

    
• 
        
International routes with +/- 3 overnight stays per week

    
    
• 
        
Additional 2 days of national transport

    
    
• 
        
A dynamic and independent role within a stable and growing company

    
    
• 
        
Positive work environment with short communication lines

    
    
• 
        
Competitive employment conditions

    

Requirements

    
• 
        
Minimum of 3 years of experience in transport

    
    
• 
        
Able to load/unload independently and open/close the curtain (baché)

    
    
• 
        
Flexible, motivated, and open-minded attitude

    
    
• 
        
EU drivers welcome – must speak good English or German

    
    
• 
        
Strong sense of responsibility regarding safety and compliance

    

Types of Goods Transported

    
• 
        
Aluminum profiles

    
    
• 
        
Automotive parts (e.g. for Honda)

    
    
• 
        
Construction materials

    
    
• 
        
Various general goods

    

Application Process Requirements 

    
• You have a CE driving license and code 95.
    
• At least 3 years of experience with a tractor-trailer.
    
• You are customer-friendly and speak good English.
    
• Basic knowledge of French, German, or Dutch is a plus!

Job description 

Depending on your location, you will start your journey from Genk, Antwerp, or Zeebrugge. You are free to choose your own departure time, provided that you leave before 5:00 a.m. Please note that you must inspect the vehicles for any damage before departure. Ensuring the load is properly secured is a key responsibility!

If you prefer to stay overnight during your routes, this can certainly be discussed.

With the loading list assigned to you, you will have a clear overview of your route and know exactly where to go.

Are you able to provide a highly secure parking location for the truck at your home? Great! If not, you will use your own vehicle to travel to the departure location each time and return the truck in excellent condition after completing your route.

You are able to communicate effectively in Dutch, French, and/or English.

 Requirements 

National routes, with occasional trips across the border to the Netherlands, Luxembourg, or France.

No experience is required; we are looking for passion and motivation for vehicle transport.

A CE driving licence, Code 95 qualification, and a valid medical fitness certificate are required.

jobs.description:

Transport of mainly sea containers in and around the port of Antwerp or Rotterdam during the night shift.

Occasionally also trailer exchange work with tarpaulin (Bache) to destinations such as Leuven or Liège.

Night work, usually shuttle runs between warehouses and terminals.

Approximately 12 hours per day.

Start between 5 PM and 6 PM, working days between 10 and 15 hours depending on workload and planning.

Good salary, departing from the right bank.

Permanent job with long-term cooperation.

 Requirements 

    
• Driving licence CE + C95

    
• Dutch or English speaking
    
• Night work

Job description 

For a large transport company, you will be working in their distribution center, moving trailers from the parking area to the loading docks and vice versa. You will do this using a Terberg (terminal tractor), a machine specifically designed for this task.

You will communicate via onboard radio with the planning team, who will assign your tasks. For smooth communication, a good knowledge of Dutch or English is required.

There are different shifts: from 04:00 to 14:00, from 05:00 to 17:00, or from 14:00 to 22:00.

A C/CE driving license is required, but Code 95 is not necessary.

 Requirements 

    
• C/CE driving license
    
• Good parking skills with tractor-trailer
    
• Sense of responsibility and focus on safety
    
• Ability to handle stress
    
• Good knowledge of Dutch or English

Job description 

Your job in a nutshell In the evening, when others go to sleep, your workday begins. Between 22h and 00h, you depart with a refrigerated truck towards your first delivery. You drive throughout Belgium and deliver to various supermarkets. No stressful city driving, but clear routes and a well-organised schedule.

What will you do? • You load and unload using an electric or manual pallet jack • You deliver fruits and vegetables to supermarkets across Belgium • You check deliveries and documents • You drive independently and take responsibility for your own route • You ensure correct and safe deliveries

What does your day look like? • You start at night at the depot, pick up your truck and depart on your route • During your shift you typically make 2 to 6 stops per night and complete your deliveries efficiently. Your workday lasts on average 12 to 15 hours, but you work within a clear and structured system without chaos or unnecessary stress • After your round, you return to the depot (Geel) and your workday is finished—and the best part? You simply sleep at home in your own bed

What do we expect from you? • CE driving licence with certificates (Code 95 – medical fitness certificate) • Good knowledge of English is a must, Lithuanian is a plus • You are flexible and customer-oriented • You live in the Geel region • You perform physical work with a smile • Willingness to work weekends (Saturdays and Sundays)

What do you get in return? • A very good salary in relation to your effort and hours • Many working hours, no hotel nights—always sleeping at home • Working with clear structure and fixed routes • Permanent contract after a successful temporary employment period

Interested? Apply today and jump on board!

 Requirements 

• CE driving licence with certificates • Flexible mindset • Good knowledge of English, Russian or Lithuanian • Living in the Geel region
